detail.longDescription: Tonight at 7:30 PM Central, I’m building my own ChatGPT integration live. Can I securely connect ChatGPT to iCloud and give it useful tools? I’ll use Codex to build and debug the software, MCP as the communication layer, and ChatGPT to test the tools. This is a real development stream: coding, configuration, accessibility, mistakes, troubleshooting, and hopefully some things working. Join me: https:// youtube.com/live/gA_ggXfPNQg # ChatGPT # Codex # MCP # iCloud # LiveCoding
